request_data.content:
Users: id, email, name, created_at
Orders: id, user_id, total_amount, status, created_at
Products: id, name, description, price, stock_quantity
OrderItems: id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price
Reviews: id, user_id, product_id, rating, comment
Categories: id, name, parent_id
ProductCategories: product_id, category_id

metadata.mermaid_code:
erDiagram
    Users {
        INT id PK "Primary Key"
        VARCHAR email
        VARCHAR name
        DATETIME created_at
    }
    Orders {
        INT id PK "Primary Key"
        INT user_id FK "Foreign Key"
        DECIMAL total_amount
        VARCHAR status
        DATETIME created_at
    }
    Products {
        INT id PK "Primary Key"
        VARCHAR name
        TEXT description
        DECIMAL price
        INT stock_quantity
    }
    OrderItems {
        INT id PK "Primary Key"
        INT order_id FK "Foreign Key"
        INT product_id FK "Foreign Key"
        INT quantity
        DECIMAL unit_price
    }
    Reviews {
        INT id PK "Primary Key"
        INT user_id FK "Foreign Key"
        INT product_id FK "Foreign Key"
        INT rating
        TEXT comment
    }
    Categories {
        INT id PK "Primary Key"
        VARCHAR name
        INT parent_id FK "Foreign Key (Self-Referencing)"
    }

    Users ||--o{ Orders : "places"
    Orders ||--o{ OrderItems : "contains"
    Products ||--o{ OrderItems : "is_part_of"
    Users ||--o{ Reviews : "writes"
    Products ||--o{ Reviews : "has"
    Categories ||--o{ Categories : "has_children"
    Products }o--o{ Categories : "belongs_to"}
